title: Complete Grammar and Vocabulary Test
description: Check your beginner English grammar and vocabulary with a mixed test, answer key and clear revision guidance.
learning_objectives: Use an answer key to assess progress

body_markdown:
## 1. Grammar and vocabulary test

Choose the best answer.

1. She ______ a nurse. (am / is / are)
2. They ______ to work every day. (go / goes / going)
3. I ______ watching television now. (am / is / are)
4. He bought ______ umbrella. (a / an / the)
5. The keys are ______ the table. (in / on / at)
6. We ______ a new manager yesterday. (meet / met / meeting)
7. I ______ call you tomorrow. (will / was / did)
8. Choose the opposite of “early”. (late / quick / soon)
9. Choose the synonym of “begin”. (finish / start / stop)
10. “Careful” means ______. (not paying attention / taking care / being late)

## 2. Complete the sentences

11. ______ you speak English? (Can / Does)
12. She ______ not like tea. (do / does)
13. There ______ two chairs in the room. (is / are)
14. I have ______ my homework. (finish / finished)
15. Please speak ______. (slow / slowly)

## 3. Writing task

Write five sentences about your daily routine. Include at least two action verbs and one time expression.

## 4. Speaking task

Speak for one minute about your work, studies or family. Use complete sentences.

## 5. Answer key

1. is; 2. go; 3. am; 4. an; 5. on; 6. met; 7. will; 8. late; 9. start; 10. taking care; 11. Can; 12. does; 13. are; 14. finished; 15. slowly.

## 6. Score guide

- 13–15: Strong result. Continue practising in real conversations.
- 10–12: Good progress. Review the questions you missed.
- 7–9: Practise the grammar topics again and retake the test.
- 0–6: Revisit the beginner lessons and work through the test slowly.

Writing and speaking are self-review tasks. Check clarity, sentence structure and whether you stayed on topic.

faq.question: How many questions are in this test?
faq.answer: There are 15 objective grammar and vocabulary questions, followed by writing and speaking tasks.

faq.question: What if I score below seven?
faq.answer: Review the relevant beginner lessons, practise examples and attempt the test again.

faq.question: Are writing and speaking automatically scored?
faq.answer: No. Use the guidance in the lesson to review clarity, grammar and relevance.
